rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created knowledge of all names in Adam's heart as an initial gift.
rows.anchor: خلق في قلبه علما بالأسماء على سبيل الابتداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God presented the named referents, including animals, inanimate things, and other entities, to the angels.
rows.anchor: عرض المسميات بالأسماء من الحيوان والجماد وغير ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to name them was a challenge meant to expose the angels' inability to know what they could see and observe.
rows.anchor: وهذا أمر تعجيز، أراد الله تعالى أن يبين عجزهم عن علم ما يرون ويعاينون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge assumes the angels claimed God would not create a creature more knowledgeable than them.
rows.anchor: أني لا أخلق خلقا أعلم منكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels' glorification rejects any objection to God's judgment, and they confess they cannot know what He has not taught them.
rows.anchor: تنزيها لك عن الاعتراض عليك في حكمك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels acknowledge their inability to know what they were not taught.
rows.anchor: اعترفوا بالعجز عن علم ما لم يعلموه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿAlīm means the All-Knowing, and al-Ḥakīm here means the Judge who rules justly.
rows.anchor: الحاكم تحكم بالحق وتقتضي به،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the angels' incapacity became clear, God told Adam to inform them of the names.
rows.anchor: فلما ظهر عجز الملائكة قال الله تعالى لآدم: { يا آدم أنبئهم بأسمائهم }.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Children of Israel are Jacob's descendants; remembering God's blessing means thanking Him for favors such as the sea's parting, rescue from Pharaoh, and cloud shade, bestowed on their ancestors and therefore also blessings for them.
rows.anchor: أولاد يعقوب عليه السلام { اذكروا } اشكروا، وذكر النعمة هو شكرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessings included the sea's parting, rescue from Pharaoh, cloud shade, and all other favors; benefits to their ancestors count as benefits to them.
rows.anchor: فلق البحر، والإنجاء من فرعون، وتظليل الغمام، إلى سائر ما أنعم الله تعالى به عليهم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving thanks for these favors requires obeying God by believing in Muhammad.
rows.anchor: وشكر هذه النعم طاعته في الإيمان بمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fulfilling God's covenant means keeping faith concerning Muhammad; God's fulfillment is admitting them to Paradise, and they must fear Him over breaking the covenant.
rows.anchor: أي: في محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم { أوف بعهدكم } أدخلكم الجنة { وإياي فارهبون } فخافوني في نقض العهد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What was sent down is the Quran, which agrees with the Torah concerning God's oneness and prophethood.
rows.anchor: يعني: القرآن { مصدقا لما معكم } موافقا للتوراة في التوحيد والنبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning concerns being the first among the People of the Book to disbelieve; Jewish scholars are addressed because their denial would lead followers into misguidance.
rows.anchor: أي: أول من يكفر به من أهل الكتاب؛ لأنكم إذا كفرتم كفر أتباعكم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's signs include Muhammad's description and attributes; a small worldly price means provisions and leadership from their followers that they feared losing.
rows.anchor: ببيان صفة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم ونعته { ثمنا قليلا } عوضا يسيرا من الدنيا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should fear God concerning Muhammad rather than fear losing their leadership.
rows.anchor: فاخشوني في أمر محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم لا ما يفوتكم من الرياسة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jews told their Muslim relatives to remain as they were, while they themselves would not believe; the verse rebukes them for urging belief in Muhammad but neglecting themselves.
rows.anchor: كانت اليهود تقول لأقربائهم من المسلمين: اثبتوا على ما أنتم عليه، ولا يؤمنون به،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Book they recited was the Torah, which describes Muhammad; they should recognize its truth and follow it.
rows.anchor: تقرؤون التوراة وفيها صفة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم ونعته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Greed, fear of losing livelihood, and love of leadership kept them from Islam, so God commanded fasting and prayer.
rows.anchor: لأنهم إنما كان يمنعهم عن الإسلام الشره، وخوف ذهاب مأكلتهم، وحب الرياسة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fasting removes greed, while prayer produces humility and removes arrogance; the intended prayer is joined with belief in Muhammad.
rows.anchor: فأمروا بالصوم الذي يذهب الشره، وبالصلاة التي تورث الخشوع، وتنفي الكبر،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience means fasting; prayer restrains indecency and wrongdoing, and seeking help through them is burdensome except for the humble, who are settled in obedience.
rows.anchor: يعني بالصوم، { والصلاة } لأنها تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر { وإنها لكبيرة } لثقيلة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: An alternative view takes this as a return to addressing Muslims, telling them to seek God's approval and Paradise through patient observance of obligations and prayer.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم: رجع بهذا القول إلى خطاب المسلمين، فأمرهم أن يستعينوا على ما يطلبونه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one food was manna and quail together; baql means plants without lasting stems, qiththa a kind of vegetable, and fūm wheat.
rows.anchor: يعني: المن الذي كانوا يأكلونه والسلوى، فكانا طعاما واحدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses calls the requested food lower and worse than the higher, better food they had.
rows.anchor: أي: أخس وأوضع { بالذي هو خير } أي: أرفع وأجل؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their requested produce is available only in towns and cities.
rows.anchor: أي: فإن] الذي سألتم لا يكون إلا في القرى والأمصار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The humiliation applies to Jews in the Prophet's era: it means the jizya and Jewish dress, imposed so they cannot escape; poverty is shown by its garb and visible misery.
rows.anchor: أي: على اليهود الذين كانوا في عصر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم { الذلة } يعني: الجزية وزي اليهودية،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To incur or return bearing something is the meaning of باؤوا; they incurred God's anger because they disbelieved signs sent to Muhammad.
rows.anchor: احتملوا وانصرفوا { بغضب من الله ذلك } أي: ذلك الضرب والغضب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The charge of killing the prophets refers to siding with those who committed the killings; killing them without right means killing them unjustly.
rows.anchor: أي: يتولون أولئك الذين فعلوا ذلك { بغير حق } أي: قتلا بغير حق، يعني: بالظلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their disbelief and killing resulted from the evil consequence of committing sins and transgressing God's command.
rows.anchor: الكفر والقتل بشؤم ركوبهم المعاصي وتجاوزهم أمر الله تعالى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The foolish people are Meccan polytheists and Medina's Jews; their question refers to Muhammad and the believers being turned from their former qibla, the Rock.
rows.anchor: يعني: مشركي مكة ويهود المدينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God owns east and west, directs people toward whichever direction He chooses, and guides whom He wills to an upright religion; He chose this qibla for Muhammad.
rows.anchor: يأمر بالتوجه إلى أي جهة شاء { يهدي من يشاء إلى صراط مستقيم } دين مستقيم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as He guided them to a straight path, God made this community just and excellent, to witness that prophets delivered their messages and with the Messenger witnessing to its truthfulness.
rows.anchor: أي: وكما هديناكم صراطا مستقيما { جعلناكم أمة وسطا } عدولا خيارا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At Judgment, nations deny receiving a message, prophets affirm delivery, and Muhammad's community testifies; it learned this from its Prophet and Scripture, after which Muhammad validates its testimony.
rows.anchor: فيشهدون لهم بالتبليغ وتكذيب قومهم إياهم، فتقول الأمم: يا رب، بم عرفوا ذلك، وكانوا بعدنا؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The qibla meant by the one the Prophet had been on is the Kaaba he is on now.
rows.anchor: أي: التي أنت عليها اليوم، وهي الكعبة، قبلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase لنعلم means that God may see who follows the Messenger by affirming the qibla's abrogation and who turns back into disbelief.
rows.anchor: { إلا لنعلم } لنرى [وقيل: معناه: لنميز] { من يتبع الرسول } في تصديقه بنسخ القبلة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative gloss takes لنعلم to mean that God distinguishes who follows the Messenger from the one who turns back.
rows.anchor: وقيل: معناه: لنميز] { من يتبع الرسول }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The change from the Rock to the Kaaba tested believers: the protected affirmed the Messenger, while others doubted, thought Muhammad confused, and apostatized; the change was burdensome except for those God guided and protected.
rows.anchor: جعل نسخ القبلة على الصخرة إلى الكعبة ابتلاء لعباده المؤمنين، فمن عصمه صدق الرسول في ذلك،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the change, Jews said Muslims who died praying toward the first qibla died astray; their faith means those prayers and their affirmation of the first qibla.
rows.anchor: فلما حولت القبلة قالت اليهود: فكيف بمن مات منكم وهو يصلي على القبلة الأولى؟ لقد مات على الضلالة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Raʾfa is more intense than mercy.
rows.anchor: والرأفة أشد الرحمة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about sending a messenger among them means completing this blessing as God completed the prior blessing by sending a messenger from among their people, whose truthfulness and lineage they knew.
rows.anchor: المعنى: ولأتم نعمتي عليكم كإرسالي إليكم رسولا، أي: أتم هذه كما أتممت تلك بإرسالي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The recited signs are the Quran; this proves Muhammad's prophethood because they knew he was unlettered and unable to read or write.
rows.anchor: يعني: القرآن، وهذا احتجاج عليهم؛ لأنهم عرفوا أنه أمي لا يقرأ ولا يكتب،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purification means directing them to commands of obedience through which they become pure.
rows.anchor: أي: يعرضكم لما تكونوا به أزكياء من الأمر بطاعة الله تعالى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering God means obeying Him, and His remembering them means forgiving them; they should thank God for His blessing and not reject it.
rows.anchor: بالطاعة { أذكركم } بالمغفرة { واشكروا لي } نعمتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers seek help in pursuing the afterlife through patience in obligations and the five daily prayers, which expiate sins.
rows.anchor: على طلب الآخرة { بالصبر } على الفرائض، { والصلاة } وبالصلوات الخمس على تمحيص الذنوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is with the patient by supporting them and not abandoning them.
rows.anchor: أي: إني معكم أنصركم ولا أخذلكم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Completing pilgrimage and umrah means carrying out their rites, boundaries, customary practices, and all requirements; being prevented means being detained and blocked from completing them.
rows.anchor: بمناسكهما وحدودهما وسننهما، وتأدية كل ما فيهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some accessible offering is obligatory; the offering is brought to God's House, with camel highest, cow intermediate, and sheep lowest.
rows.anchor: وهو ما يهدى إلى بيت الله سبحانه، أعلاه بدنة، وأوسطه بقرة، وأدناه شاة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Not shaving the head means not leaving consecration; the Iraqis hold that the offering reaches its place when slaughtered in Mecca.
rows.anchor: أي: لا تحلوا من إحرامكم { حتى يبلغ الهدي محله } حتى ينحر الهدي بمكة في بعض الأقوال، وهو مذهب أهل العراق،

rows.speaker: غيرهم
rows.claim: Others, including al-Shafiʿi, hold that the offering's place is wherever slaughter is lawful, namely where the pilgrim was prevented.
rows.anchor: وفي قول غيرهم: محله حيث يحل ذبحه ونحره، وهو حيث أحصر، وهو مذهب الشافعي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A sick person or someone whose scalp has abundant vermin may shave and owes a ransom: three days of fasting, food for six poor people at two mudd each, or an animal sacrifice.
rows.anchor: [يعني الهوام تقع في الشعر وتكثر] فحلق { ففدية من صيام } وهو صيام ثلاثة أيام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Safety means being safe from an enemy, or undertaking a pilgrimage without fear of an enemy.
rows.anchor: أي: من العدو، أو كان حج ليس فيه خوف من عدو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tamattuʿ is arriving in Mecca in consecration, performing umrah in the pilgrimage months, remaining released there until beginning that year's hajj, and enjoying the restrictions lifted by umrah.
rows.anchor: أي: قدم مكة محرما واعتمر في أشهر الحج، وأقام حلالا بمكة حتى ينشىء منها الحج عامه ذلك،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tamattuʿ pilgrim owes an accessible offering; one unable to afford it fasts three days during pilgrimage and seven after completing it, ten days in all.
rows.anchor: فمن لم يجد } ثمن الهدي { فصيام ثلاثة أيام في } أشهر { الحج وسبعة إذا رجعتم } أي: بعد الفراغ من الحج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rule applies to those whose families are not residents of Mecca.
rows.anchor: أي: لمن لم يكن من أهل مكة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One must not deliberately use an oath by God as a pretext blocking goodness, piety, or reconciliation; the verse was revealed about ʿAbd Allah ibn Rawaha, who vowed not to speak to his in-law or intervene in a dispute.
rows.anchor: لا تجعلوا اليمين بالله سبحانه علة مانعة من البر والتقوى من حيث تتعمدون اليمين لتعتلوا بها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase أن تبروا can mean that you do not do good, or that the oath is meant to prevent you from doing good.
rows.anchor: أي: في أن لا تبروا، أو لدفع أن تبروا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, أن تبروا begins a clause with an omitted predicate: goodness, piety, and reconciliation among people are better.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون قوله: { أن تبروا } ابتداء، وخبره محذوف على تقدير: أن تبروا وتتقوا وتصلحوا بين الناس أولى،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears their oaths and knows their intentions in making them.
rows.anchor: يسمع أيمانكم، ويعلم ما تقصدون بها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Vain oaths are unintentional words that slip from the tongue as conversational fillers, such as no or yes, by God.
rows.anchor: ما يسبق به اللسان من غير عقد ولا قصد، ويكون كالصلة للكلام،

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view calls an expiable oath vain because expiation removes its sin.
rows.anchor: وقيل: لغو اليمين: اليمين المكفرة، سميت لغوا لأن الكفارة تسقط الإثم منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What hearts earn means what people resolve and intend; on the second view, God holds them to their resolve not to do good and their use of an oath as an excuse.
rows.anchor: أي: عزمتم وقصدتم، وعلى القول الثاني في لغو اليمين معناه: ولكن يؤاخذكم بعزمكم على ألا تبروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is forgiving and forbearing, delaying punishment for disbelievers and sinners.
rows.anchor: يؤخر العقوبة عن الكفار والعصاة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse was revealed when al-ʿAbbas and ʿUthman sought interest from loans advanced before its prohibition; they obeyed and took only their principal.
rows.anchor: نزلت في العباس وعثمان رضي الله عنهما طلبا ربا لهما كانا قد أسلفا قبل نزول التحريم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse forbids outstanding interest debt and requires taking only principal, with no increase as interest.
rows.anchor: تحريم ما بقي دينا من الربا، وإيجاب أخذ رأس المال دون الزيادة على جهة الربا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase if you are believers means that this is the rule for anyone who is a believer.
rows.anchor: أي: إن من كان مؤمنا فهذا حكمه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they refuse to abandon the remaining interest, they should know that their refusal puts them at war with God and His Messenger.
rows.anchor: فأيقنوا أنكم في امتناعكم من وضع ذلك حرب لله ورسوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After repenting of usury, creditors may take their principal without wronging borrowers through an increase or being wronged by receiving less.
rows.anchor: فلكم رؤوس أموالكم لا تظلمون } بطلب الزيادة { ولا تظلمون } بالنقصان عن رأس المال.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When a debtor is insolvent, creditors must give respite until the debtor becomes wealthy and has money; forgiving the principal is better.
rows.anchor: أي: وإن وقع غريم ذو عسرة] { فنظرة } أي: فعليكم نظرة، أي: تأخير { إلى ميسرة } إلى غنى ووجود المال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgiving insolvent debtors the principal is better for creditors.
rows.anchor: على المعسرين برأس المال { خير لكم }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent the Quran with truth in its reports, confirming what earlier scriptures had foretold, and sent the Torah and Gospel.
rows.anchor: { نزل عليك الكتاب } أي: القرآن { بالحق } بالصدق في إخباره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran confirms what was foretold in earlier scriptures.
rows.anchor: { مصدقا لما بين يديه } موافقا لما تقدم الخبر به في سائر الكتب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Furqan means all the books God revealed, which distinguish truth from falsehood.
rows.anchor: فرق به بين الحق والباطل. يعني: جميع الكتب التي أنزلها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who disbelieve God's signs face severe punishment, and God is mighty and possesses retribution.
rows.anchor: { إن الذين كفروا بآيات الله لهم عذاب شديد والله عزيز ذو انتقام } ذو عقوبة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God forms people in their mothers' wombs as He wills, including male or female, short or tall, black or white.
rows.anchor: يجعلكم على صور في أرحام الأمهات { كيف يشاء } ذكرا وأنثى، قصيرا وطويلا، وأسود وأبيض.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the Doubtless Day, everyone is fully repaid for deeds without good being reduced or evil increased.
rows.anchor: وفيت كل نفس } جزاء { ما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون } بنقصان حسناتهم أو زيادة سيئاتهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the Prophet conquered Mecca and promised Persia's and Rome's kingdoms, hypocrites and Jews scoffed that those powers were too strong and secure for Muslims to conquer.
rows.anchor: لما فتح رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مكة، ووعد أمته ملك فارس والروم قالت المنافقون واليهود: هيهات هيهات،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives dominion to Muhammad and his Companions, removes it from Abu Jahl and Quraysh's leaders, honors the Emigrants and Helpers, and humiliates Abu Jahl's followers, whose heads were cast into the well.
rows.anchor: { تؤتي الملك من تشاء } محمدا وأصحابه { وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء } أبي جهل وصناديد قريش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good in God's hand means honor in this life and the next; good alone is named because God prefers doing good to His servant over evil.
rows.anchor: أي: عز الدنيا والآخرة، وأراد: الخير والشر، فاكتفى بذكر الخير، لأن الرغبة إليه في فعل الخير بالعبد دون الشر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What God revealed to Muhammad is the true account.
rows.anchor: الذين أوحيناه إليك { لهو القصص الحق } الخبر الصدق.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they turn away from the clear explanation, God knows which of His creatures corrupts and will requite them.
rows.anchor: أعرضوا عما أتيت به من البيان { فإن الله } يعلم من يفسد من خلقه فيجازيه على ذلك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The People of the Book addressed are the Jews of Medina and Christians of Najran; the even word means just speech explaining the account.
rows.anchor: يعني: يهود المدينة، ونصارى نجران { تعالوا إلى كلمة سواء } معنى الكلمة: كلام فيه شرح قصة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call to worship God alone means worshipping no one alongside Him; taking people as lords refers to Christians treating Jesus and Israelites treating Ezra as lords.
rows.anchor: أي: لا نعبد معه غيره { ولا يتخذ بعضنا بعضا أربابا من دون الله } كما اتخذت النصارى عيسى، وبنو إسرائيل عزيرا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation forbids obeying anyone in disobedience to God, as in the statement about taking rabbis and monks as lords.
rows.anchor: وقيل: لا نطيع أحدا في معصية الله، كما قال الله في صفتهم لما أطاعوا في معصيته علماءهم:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they refuse the invitation, Muslims should call them to witness that Muslims submit and affirm God's oneness.
rows.anchor: أعرضوا عن الإجابة { فقولوا اشهدوا بأنا مسلمون } مقرون بالتوحيد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A group of Jews twists Scripture with alteration and substitution, deviating from what is correct through their own inventions so people think it is scripture.
rows.anchor: يحرفونه بالتغيير والتبديل، والمعنى: يلوون ألسنتهم عن سنن الصواب بما يأتونه به من عند أنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Jews claimed to follow Abraham's religion and God disproved them, they angrily said Muhammad wanted them to take him as a lord; the Prophet denied commanding worship of anyone but God, and the verse was revealed.
rows.anchor: لما ادعت اليهود أنهم على دين إبراهيم عليه السلام وكذبهم الله تعالى غضبوا وقالوا: ما يرضيك منا يا محمد إلا أن نتخذك ربا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A human cannot combine prophethood with calling people to worship someone other than God.
rows.anchor: أن يجمع بين هذين: بين النبوة وبين دعاء الخلق إلى عبادة غير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being rabbaniyyun means becoming teachers through knowledge and study, teaching and explaining; the Prophet said this to Jews because they knew what the Arabs did not.
rows.anchor: أي: يقول: كونوا معلمي الناس بعلمكم ودرسكم، علموا الناس وبينوا لهم،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet said this to Jews because they were People of the Book and knew what the Arabs did not.
rows.anchor: وكذا كان يقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لليهود؛ لأنهم كانوا أهل كتاب يعلمون ما لا تعلمه العرب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No soul dies except by God's decree and predestination, in the fixed term He set; fleeing battle does not prolong life.
rows.anchor: إلا بإذن الله } بقضائه وقدره، كتب الله ذلك { كتابا مؤجلا } إلى أجله الذي قدر له، فلم انهزمتم؟ والهزيمة لا تزيد في الحياة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever seeks worldly reward through deeds receives the share God allotted; this describes the defeated who sought booty, while those seeking the afterlife stood firm until killed.
rows.anchor: [أي: لهؤلاء المنهزمين طلبا للغنيمة]، { ومن يرد ثواب الآخرة } يعني: الذين ثبتوا حتى قتلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Many prophets fought in battle alongside many groups of devoted followers; they did not lose heart or weaken after their prophet was killed, and God loves the patient.
rows.anchor: أي: وكم { من نبي قتل } في معركة { معه ربيون كثير } جماعات كثيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those followers did not weaken after their prophet was killed; God loves the patient.
rows.anchor: أي: ما ضعفوا بعد قتل نبيهم... الآية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After their prophet was killed, his companions asked God to forgive their sins and excess beyond their limits, and to strengthen them through His power and victory.
rows.anchor: أي: قول أصحاب ذلك النبي المقتول عند الحرب بعد قتل نبيهم { إلا أن قالوا ربنا اغفر لنا ذنوبنا وإسرافنا } تجاوزنا ما حد لنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's covenant with the Jews in the Torah required them to explain Muhammad's identity, attributes, and advent rather than conceal them; they discarded it and failed to act on it.
rows.anchor: أخذ الله ميثاق اليهود في التوراة ليبينن شأن محمد ونعته ومبعثه، ولا يخفونه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They sold the covenant cheaply for status among their followers from scholarly leadership; their bargain was evil and a loss.
rows.anchor: أي: ما كانوا يأخذونه من سفلتهم برئاستهم في العلم { فبئس ما يشترون } قبح شراؤهم وخسروا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Jews rejoiced at misleading people and being treated as learned despite not being learned, and wanted praise for supposedly adhering to truth and possessing ancient knowledge.
rows.anchor: هم اليهود فرحوا بإضلال الناس، وبنسبة الناس إياهم إلى العلم، وليسوا كذلك،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being safe from punishment is the meaning of مفازة.
rows.anchor: بمنجاة { من العذاب }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God owns the heavens and earth and directs them as He wills.
rows.anchor: أي: يملك تدبيرهما وتصريفهما على ما يشاء. الآية والتي بعدها ذكرت في سورة البقرة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address يا أيها الناس means the people of Mecca; the single soul is Adam, and his spouse Eve was created from one of his ribs.
rows.anchor: { يا أيها الناس } يا أهل مكة { اتقوا ربكم الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة } آدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bithth means spreading and dispersing people from Adam and Eve.
rows.anchor: { وبث } أي: فرق ونشر { منهما } ، { واتقوا الله }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People ask one another for needs and rights by invoking God, and the command about wombs means fearing God about severing family ties.
rows.anchor: أي: تتساءلون فيما بينكم حوائجكم وحقوقكم به، وتقولون: أسألك بالله، وأنشدك الله،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God watches and preserves their deeds, so they should fear Him in what He commands and forbids.
rows.anchor: أي: حافظا يرقب عليكم أعمالكم، فاتقوه فيما أمركم به ونهاكم عنه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guardians and trustees must give orphans their property when they reach maturity; replacing bad property with good means taking the good and substituting something inferior.
rows.anchor: الخطاب للأولياء والأوصياء، أي: أعطوهم أموالهم إذا بلغوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Replacing the orphan's unlawful property with one's lawful property refers to taking the good and substituting something inferior.
rows.anchor: من أموالهم الحرام [عليكم] { بالطيب } الحلال من مالكم، وهو أنه كان ولي اليتيم يأخذ الجيد من ماله، ويجعل مكانه الرديء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating orphan property along with one's own means adding it to one's food when needing it; consuming it is a grave sin.
rows.anchor: لا تضيفوها في الأكل إلى أموالكم إذا احتجتم إليها { إنه } أي: إن أكل أموالهم { كان حوبا كبيرا } أي: إثما كبيرا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When a man divorces his wife to marry another, he may not reclaim her dowry even if he gave her a great amount; taking it back is wrongful and a manifest sin.
rows.anchor: أي: إذا أراد الرجل طلاق امرأته، وتزوج غيرها لم يكن له أن يرجع فيما آتاها من المهر،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibition includes harming a wife to make her ransom herself when she committed no sexual misconduct.
rows.anchor: وفي هذا نهي عن الضرار في غير حال الفاحشة، وهو أن يضارها لتفتدي منه من غير أن أتت بفاحشة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Having been together means sexual intercourse, after which none of the dowry may be reclaimed; the solemn covenant requires men to retain wives honorably or release them graciously.
rows.anchor: أي: وصل إليه بالمجامعة، ولا يجوز الرجوع في شيء من المهر بعد الجماع { وأخذن منكم ميثاقا غليظا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arab men used to marry their fathers' wives after the fathers died; though once permissible among Arabs, God prohibited it, and prior instances are pardoned.
rows.anchor: كان الرجل من العرب يتزوج امرأة أبيه من بعده، وكان ذلك نكاحا جائزا في العرب، فحرمه الله تعالى ونهى عنه،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What preceded means former practice is pardoned; that marriage was, in God's sight, fornication, intense hatred, and an evil path.
rows.anchor: يعني: لكن ما قد سلف فإن الله تجاوز عنه { إنه } أي: إن ذلك النكاح { كان فاحشة } زنا عند الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A stepdaughter is a wife's daughter by another man; being in one's care means under one's guardianship and upbringing. Ḥalāʾil are wives, and sons from one's loins excludes adopted sons.
rows.anchor: جمع الربيبة، وهي بنت امرأة الرجل من غيره { اللاتي في حجوركم } أي: في ضمانكم وتربيتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Combining two sisters means marrying them simultaneously; pre-Islamic instances are pardoned.
rows.anchor: أي: الجمع { بين الأختين إلا ما قد سلف } مضى منكم في الجاهلية، فلا تؤاخذون به بعد الإسلام.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Married women are prohibited except women captured in enemy territory, who become lawful to their captor after a waiting period of one menstrual cycle; God's book prescribes these prohibitions.
rows.anchor: وهن محرمات على كل أحد غير أزواجهن إلا ما ملكتموهن بالسبي من دار الحرب؛ فإنها تحل لمالكها بعد الاستبراء بحيضة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Women beyond those listed may be sought with one's wealth through marriage and a dowry or ownership; muḥṣinīn means marrying, and non-fornicators means avoiding illicit sex.
rows.anchor: أي: تطلبوا بأموالكم؛ إما بنكاح وصداق؛ أو بملك يمين { محصنين } ناكحين { غير مسافحين } زانين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Enjoyment refers to benefit and pleasure through a valid marriage, and their due is the dowry; after consummation the full dowry is owed, but only half if there has been only a contract.
rows.anchor: فما انتفعتم وتلذذتم { به منهن } أي: من النساء بالنكاح الصحيح { فآتوهن أجورهن } أي: مهورهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the dowry is fixed, mutual agreement may reduce or waive part or all of it; God knows what benefits people and is wise in explaining marriage.
rows.anchor: من حط المهر أو إبراء من بعض الصداق أو كله { إن الله كان عليما } بما يصلح أمر العباد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claim of belief is false if they oppose the Prophet's judgment; true faith requires making him judge in disputes, feeling no inner distress or doubt, and submitting completely.
rows.anchor: أي: ليس الأمر كما يزعمون أنهم آمنوا وهم يخالفون حكمك { وربك لا يؤمنون } حقيقة الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The matter in dispute means what has become confused and contentious; distress means inner constriction and doubt.
rows.anchor: اختلف واختلط { بينهم ثم لا يجدوا في أنفسهم حرجا } ضيقا وشكا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypothetical addressees are hypocrites from among the Jews; killing themselves recalls the command given to the Children of Israel, and leaving their homes recalls the command given to the Emigrants.
rows.anchor: أي: على هؤلاء المنافقين [من اليهود] { أن اقتلوا أنفسكم } كما كتبنا ذلك على بني إسرائيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only a few would have obeyed because it was difficult, although they should have done so; following the Quran's rulings would improve worldly life and reward and make them firmer in faith.
rows.anchor: للمشقة فيه مع أنه كان ينبغي أن يفعلوه { ولو أنهم فعلوا ما يوعظون به } ما يؤمرون به من أحكام القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A great reward from God means Paradise, which no one else can provide.
rows.anchor: أي: مما لا يقدر عليه غيرنا { أجرا عظيما } أي: الجنة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is the religion of ḥanīfism, not Judaism.
rows.anchor: وهو دين الحنيفية لا دين اليهودية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muslims told the Prophet they had only this world with him and feared his higher station in the afterlife; their sadness and his led to the verse's revelation.
rows.anchor: قال المسلمون للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: ما لنا منك إلا الدنيا، فإذا كانت الآخرة رفعت في الأعلى، فحزن وحزنوا، فنزلت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Obeying God means carrying out obligations, and obeying the Messenger means following his customary practices; the blessed may be seen and visited.
rows.anchor: { ومن يطع الله } في الفرائض { والرسول } في السنن { فأولئك مع الذين أنعم الله عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed groups are prophets, the foremost companions of prophets, those killed in God's path, and the righteous among the other people of Paradise; they are excellent companions.
rows.anchor: أفاضل أصحاب الأنبياء { والشهداء } القتلى في سبيل الله { والصالحين } أي: أهل الجنة من سائر المسلمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proof from God is the Prophet, and the manifest light is the Quran.
rows.anchor: يعني: النبي عليه السلام { وأنزلنا إليكم نورا مبينا } وهو القرآن.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Holding fast to God means using obedience to Him to protect oneself from Satan's deviation; God's mercy means Paradise and His grace means giving them what never occurred to their hearts.
rows.anchor: أي: امتنعوا بطاعته من زيغ الشيطان { فسيدخلهم في رحمة منه } يعني: الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path to God is an upright religion.
rows.anchor: { ويهديهم إليه صراطا مستقيما } دينا مستقيما.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kalāla means a person who dies leaving neither child nor father; the parent is also absent in the phrase about dying without a child, with only one named because this is kalāla.
rows.anchor: فيمن مات ولا ولد له، ولا والد { إن امرؤ هلك ليس له ولد } أراد: ولا والد، فاكتفى بذكر أحدهما، لأنه الكلالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A sister, either full or paternal, inherits half; a brother inherits all from a sister who leaves no child.
rows.anchor: يعني: من أب وأم، أو أب؛ لأن ذكر ولد الأم قد مضى في أول السورة { فلها نصف ما ترك وهو يرثها } الأخ يرث الأخت جميع المال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Two sisters receive two-thirds, and male and female siblings of the same paternal or full line divide with the male receiving twice the female's share.
rows.anchor: من أب وأم أو من أب { فللذكر مثل حظ الأنثيين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about not going astray means so that you do not go astray, or lest you go astray; God knows everything about inheritance division.
rows.anchor: أي: أن لا تضلوا، أو كراهة أن تضلوا [ { والله بكل شيء عليم } من قسمة المواريث]
